statement: ROOT consequence of the all-mean reserve: fix k,c_k>0, put Z=L_(k,A)D^2psi and Y=Dphi-Z with phi periodic W1,4. If ||Y||2<=epsilon||Z||2 AND ||Y||4<=epsilon||Z||4, choose a finite coefficient bound C_k for the original translated quartic difference. Holder and |A|||Z||2||Z||4^2<=(|A|^2||Z||2^2+||Z||4^4)/2 bound the integrated perturbation cost by8C_k epsilon R_A for epsilon<=1, R_A=|A|^2||Z||2^2+||Z||4^4. Thus epsilon<=min(1,c_k/(16C_k)) gives <J(A+Dphi)>-J(A)>=c_k R_A/2. Tangent and determinant cancel for the FULL compatible field. This is an arbitrary-amplitude relative cone uniform over affine means (and compact parameter intervals with their constants), not a decomposition making every vector field satisfy it or a numerical acquired epsilon. It is a standard consequence, not independent discovery credit or a second copy of older relative-cone machinery.
